Create a distinct conditional claim for a newly added premise.
Keep referenced unproved prerequisites visible even when upstream says validated/clean.
Deleting or archiving a step cannot erase a frozen obligation.
Reject escaped assumptions or export an explicitly conditional statement.
Reject splitting joint premises into independent entailments.
Reject self-review hidden by actor aliases.
Reject axiom targets, unapproved premises or omitted build targets as formal support.
A failed proof attempt produces failure/blocking, not a refutation.
Separate a successful formal statement from a source claim that fails alignment.
Separate conclusion support from the contribution of an original proof method.
Reject mismatched scientific uses without erasing conditional mathematics.
Invalidate only affected proof schemes while preserving independent alternatives.
A new upstream release does not change old bindings; explicit adoption triggers checks.
A search miss in a bounded baseline does not imply global originality.
Keep comparison baseline separate from pre-ingestion snapshot.
Reject stale reviews and prevent partial concurrent admission.
Archiving and indexing do not imply admission or positive scientific status.
Preserve V1/V2 and study-assumed meanings without filling missing axes with success.
Query filtering cannot hide relevant conflict or mutate canonical scope.
Report no improvement honestly in a scope-matched argument-layer comparison.
Stable identity after workspace relocation.
Missing scope/context prevents a complete handoff.
Non-tree unproved dependencies constrain affected support.
Actor aliases do not provide independence.
All proof contributors participate in conflict checks.
Archived steps retain required obligations.
Scope changes invalidate old review despite unchanged node hashes.
Changed validation dependencies follow the pinned hash semantics.
Ledger/export disagreement rejects import and preserves evidence.
A checkpoint mismatch rejects rewritten history; no checkpoint means no history-integrity claim.
Undischarged local assumptions do not escape their scope.
Only affected schemes lose current support.
